Alex Chen: hey @jamie-it I'm stuck during Okta sign-in on my Mac (Ventura). After I insert YubiKey the browser just refreshes and sends me back to login. :confused:
Jamie (IT): hey Alex—what browser? did you try in an incognito window? Also which yubikey model?
Alex Chen: Safari 16.1; YubiKey 5C NFC. Tried incognito + clearing cookies, same. 1Password prompts worked though. I also see an 'SSO prompt' blink then go back.
Linda (People Ops): adding @jamie-it and @matt in case this needs eng help for SSO config. Also FYI you should be able to use Okta Verify app if yubikey fails.
Matt (eng): hi Alex—can you try `sudo pkill -f 'Okta'` then open browser? sometimes the okta helper process hangs. also try Chrome if possible.
Alex Chen: running that now... no luck. attaching a quick screenshot: https://rwd-inf.company/screencaps/1790005123-1.png
Jamie (IT): Got it. Can you try disabling the `1Password` extension in Safari? We had a bug where password managers intercept the redirect. Also try plugging YubiKey in a different USB port.
Alex Chen: Ok turned off 1Password extension and used Chrome — success! Logged in and MFA registered. Thanks :tada:
Jamie (IT): sweet. Follow-up: we pushed a note to new-hires doc about Safari + 1Password interactions. @linda please update onboarding checklist to suggest Chrome for initial SSO.
Linda (People Ops): will do. Welcome aboard @Alex Chen :wave:
okta-bot: [system] MFA enrollment complete for alex.chen@redwood.com
